itens.titulo: Did Foundry Win Just Shift Intel (INTC) Investment Narrative?
itens.descricao: Did Foundry Win Just Shift Intel (INTC) Investment Narrative? Yahoo Finance
trechos: - Intel recently disclosed new details on its GPU D-series for high memory AI inference, outlined Xeon-based racks for agentic AI workloads, and confirmed Tesla as a future 14A foundry customer alongside deeper software distribution ties with Anaconda.
See where Intel's AI strategy fits within the broader buildout and compare other hardware players riding the same wave with our hand picked 55 AI infrastructure stocks.
The Tesla 14A foundry agreement is the announcement that ties closest to this story.

Consensus expects revenue to grow by 16.5% a year over the next three years, profit margins to move from a loss of 19.8% today to a 24.2% margin in three years, and earnings to lift from a current loss of US$11.3b to US$21.8b by 2029.
Those earnings forecasts are not tight either, with estimates spanning from US$8.8b to US$38.1b, which shows how differently people view the payoff from the foundry buildout and AI product push.

itens.titulo: 3M stock rises 3% on $6B Amazon data center deal
itens.descricao: 3M stock rises 3% on $6B Amazon data center deal Yahoo Finance
trechos: Investing.com -- 3M Company (NYSE:MMM) shares rose 3% in after-hours trading after the company announced a strategic commercial agreement with Amazon involving data center products.

The industrial conglomerate issued a warrant to an Amazon subsidiary to purchase up to 3,162,015 shares of 3M common stock over a seven-year period at $164.89 per share, according to a securities filing.
The deal, formalized on October 19, 2026, centers on 3M supplying optical connectivity and other data center products to Amazon.
Under the warrant structure, 85% of the shares will vest based on cumulative payments from Amazon for data center products, with full vesting occurring once payments reach $6 billion.
The agreement represents an expanded strategic commercial relationship between the two companies, positioning 3M as a supplier for Amazon's data center infrastructure needs.

itens.titulo: Dólar hoje cai a R$ 5,04, reagindo a disputa eleitoral no Brasil e seguindo exterior
itens.descricao: Dólar hoje cai a R$ 5,04, reagindo a disputa eleitoral no Brasil e seguindo exterior InfoMoney
trechos: O dólar à vista encerrou a sessão com queda de 0,50%, a R$5,0476.
No ano, a divisa passou a acumular baixa de 8,04%.
Às 17h15, o dólar futuro para novembro — o mais negociado no Brasil — cedia 0,33% na B3, aos R$5,0630.
Dólar comercial - Compra: R$ 5,047 - Venda: R$ 5,047 O que aconteceu com o dólar hoje?
Na BTG/Nexus, Flávio soma 46,5% e Lula tem 45,9%, em empate técnico dentro da margem de erro de 2 pontos percentuais para mais ou para menos.

Já na AtlasIntel, contratada pela Bloomberg, o senador soma 49,8% e o presidente fica com 47,6%, uma vantagem de 2,2 pontos percentuais, portanto acima da margem de erro da pesquisa que é de 1 ponto percentual para mais ou para menos.
“Então não me parece que (as pesquisas) mudem o humor do mercado ou as apostas — apenas vem com um pouco mais de tensão e adrenalina”, afirmou, ao justificar a movimentação do câmbio ao longo do dia.
O Relatório Focus também mostrou queda na projeção para o dólar ao fim do ano, de R$ 5,15 para R$ 5,13, enquanto a expectativa para a taxa básica de juros, a Selic, permaneceu em 13,25% ao ano.

itens.titulo: Ibovespa fecha com leve queda, com olhos na eleição; dólar cai a R$ 5,04
itens.descricao: Ibovespa fecha com leve queda, com olhos na eleição; dólar cai a R$ 5,04 InfoMoney
trechos: O Ibovespa fechou praticamente sem sair do lugar: menos 0,17%, aos 205.079,25 pontos, uma queda pequena de 351,08 pontos.
“O trade eleitoral dita o pregão e o exterior ajuda na margem, com Nova York em alta, petróleo em queda e dólar mais fraco”, disse Ricardo Trevisan, CEO da Gravus Capital.
O real conseguiu uma valorização, com o dólar comercial em baixa de 0,49%, a R$ 5,048.
O próximo debate é na Rede Globo, sexta-feira (23), que tem a tradição de ser decisivo em eleições nacionais.
Antes, saem novas pesquisas: quarta-feira (21), tem a Quaest, e no dia seguinte, tem o Datafolha.
De um lado, as ações da Petrobras (PETR4) desabaram de um jeito pouco usual, diante do comportamento do petróleo internacional: menos 2,82%.
As petroleiras juniores foram um pouco melhor, com PRIO (PRIO3) avançando 1,28%.
CONTINUA DEPOIS DA PUBLICIDADE Os bancos desceram em sua maioria, com Bradesco (BBDC4) caindo 1,28%, o Itaú Unibanco (ITUB4) perdendo 0,40% e o Santander (SANB11) cedendo 1,80%.

itens.titulo: Buy Top-Ranked Tech Stock TSMC Now on the Dip and Hold
itens.descricao: Buy Top-Ranked Tech Stock TSMC Now on the Dip and Hold Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: Technology, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence stocks jumped on Monday as the bulls attempt to push the Nasdaq back above its 50-day moving average heading into the heart of big tech earnings—Meta, Tesla, and others report later this week.
The tech stock we dive into today—Taiwan Semiconductor—reported a strong beat-and-raise Q3 on October 15.
TSMC's strong upward earnings revisions earn the chip maker a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) right now.
Plus, Taiwan Semi has slipped ~14% from its early October records and is finding technical support.

Earnings Growth Tells Investors to Buy Stocks Right Now Nearly every Zacks sector (15 out of 16) is expected to report YoY growth in the third quarter, highlighting a bullish backdrop beyond AI and Tech.
Total third-quarter earnings are projected to jump 24.6% for the S&P 500, on 11.8% revenue expansion.
Even taking the Tech sector out of the equation completely, S&P 500 earnings are projected to jump 14.5% in Q3.
But Q3's strength is already priced into the market in a big way.

itens.titulo: Amazon shares jump as Morgan Stanley calls AWS runway “under-appreciated”
itens.descricao: Amazon shares jump as Morgan Stanley calls AWS runway “under-appreciated” Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: Amazon.com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) shares rose more than 5% on Monday after Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) named the company a top pick and raised its price target to $350 from $335.
The firm sees roughly 40% upside as Amazon Web Services accelerates, and now models AWS growth of 47% in 2027, up from 41%.
It projects 47% and 42% year-over-year growth through 2027 and 2028.
Morgan Stanley expects AWS to operate as a "rule of 90" company in 2027 and 2028, with operating margins of 42% to 44%.
That would pave the way for Amazon to generate about $16.50 of earnings per share in 2028, the analyst said, a figure derived from 21 times earnings.
"We continue to think AWS's growth and profit runway is under-appreciated," analysts wrote.
These include AWS growth re-accelerating to 47% in 2027 after Nvidia flagged that 2 million GPUs are headed to AWS, and AWS operating margins reaching 42% to 44%.
Morgan Stanley called Amazon "a key agentic enabler and winner," and said Meta's Muse does not change that view.
